term & what it is & numerical treatment & dominant limitation \\
\hline
$C_1$ & sampled Monte-Carlo probability & $P(\ge 1$ explosion in the required age window$)$, per branch & \raggedright inherits the age and IMF branch structure; spans a factor of two across the headline set \tabularnewline
$C_3$ & deterministic model mapping & indicator that the progenitor exceeded $30\,M_\odot$ & \raggedright returns exactly unity because the ledger's mass floor lies above the threshold; falls to 0.68 under a $60\,M_\odot$ assumption \tabularnewline
$C_4$ & upper bound & held fixed at 0.854 & \raggedright a two-dimensional, footprint-limited runaway census of \emph{living} stars below the turnoff, applied to dead and more massive progenitors \tabularnewline
